mutations.label: rate: a value outside the vocabulary is excluded, never counted as held
mutations.only: ^(?:a claim or evidence value this does not recognise is excluded, not counted as held)$

mutations.label: rate: a withdrawn arm is named, so a structural zero is not read as clean
mutations.only: ^(?:a retired arm is named in the rate with what replaces it, and a live one is not)$

mutations.label: claims: could-not-look is in neither half of the rate
mutations.only: ^(?:the four buckets are disjoint, total, and the excluded ones are in neither half|--json carries the same buckets as the text|a claim or evidence value this does not recognise is excluded, not counted as held)$

mutations.label: claims: a rate over zero rows is not a rate of zero
claims: an unreadable row stays in the total instead of shrinking it
mutations.only: ^(?:a malformed row is counted and named, never dropped)$
